title: Canonical scalar, site, composition and refinement data for chosen compactifications
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring R and a scheme X, realization is the identity on the etale site and the etale-to-proetale derived pullback on the proetale site. For a compactification c=(j,p), support is Rp_* j_!. coefficientMap is the specified proper scalar mate followed by open balancing on the etale site, and the scalar-adjunction transpose of the restriction-of-scalars compact-support isomorphism on the proetale site. The composition and refinement arrows are the existing D-plus normalized compositors and comparisons, conjugated along the retained input isomorphisms. SiteCompatibility is the displayed mixed scalar/site equality. These are precisely the nine original constructions attached to lem-pur-finite-free-compact-composition, relocated without changing their bodies or signatures.
